mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 6% in the next quarter signals anticipated monetary tightening, reducing growth expectations and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE stays below 6% or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: When demand growth (GDPC1) outpaces housing demand (HOUST), it indicates robust economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings and equity prices, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > HOUST growth in the next month
failure_condition: The interaction reverses or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in employment (PAYEMS) while a decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, fostering productivity gains and corporate profitability, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 5,000 and UNRATE falls < 7.0% in the next month
failure_condition: The interaction reverses or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), sustained higher interest rates reduce growth prospects, compressing equity valuations and generating negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0% in the past month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not stay above 2.0% or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the tightening phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, fostering economic growth and corporate profitability, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE stops declining or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 10% in the next month signals robust economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 10% in the next month
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not meet the threshold or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained supply growth (INDPRO rising > 5% over 3 months) in an expanding economy indicates healthy business activity, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 5% in the next quarter
failure_condition: INDPRO does not meet the threshold or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during the expansion phase.
